messages.text: Hello! I would like to exchange a pair of mittens I bought. Although I followed the instructions and bought the pair that matched my hand measurement, I just find them too big and cumbersome. My order number is L-41090.
I did measure my hands to end up with a medium, but, as you can see, the actual mitten is a lot bigger than my hand.

messages.subject: Mittens too big
messages.text:
Good afternoon, 

 Although the mittens I ordered (L-41090 (https://lasclay.com/en/account/orders/5066ee9a909685037928b00394305ee8)) seem very warm, they are too big for my hands. I have inserted some photos below to show that I tried to follow the size guide, which is how I ended up with a medium, but a medium isn't right for me. I would like to exchange the mittens for a smaller size. 
 

 Thank you, 
 

 April

messages.subject: Re: Mittens too big
messages.text:
Hi April,
 

 We have received your message and are doing our utmost to respond and assist you as quickly as possible. It's a busy time for messages, and our customer service team is still quite small: just 1 full-time person and me, who helps out occasionally amidst my dozens of other tasks!
 

 Rest assured, however, that your situation will not be overlooked, and we will take care of it as soon as possible. It is understood that the return period applies from the time the customer notifies us of a desire to make an exchange or a refund, not from when we have time to respond. Serving our customers well is a high priority for us, even if we are sometimes a bit overwhelmed.
 

 In short, we haven't forgotten about you and we're working hard to not let you down!

messages.subject: Re: Mittens too big
messages.text:
Hello April,
 

 According to your photos, the right size for you is actually Small 😊
 

 Here are the steps for a return/exchange: 
 

 1. Visit https://lasclay.happyreturns.com/ to obtain a return label. After entering your order number and zip code, select the products you wish to return and then choose the replacements. At the end, you will receive a prepaid return label.
 

 2. Print the label, pack the products to be returned, and affix the label to the package. Please prefer using envelopes/bags instead of boxes, which are more expensive.
 

 3. Drop it off at a Canada Post red box or the nearest post office.
 

 4. Once the return is received, if applicable, we will request a $9.99 exchange fee. 😊
 

 Warmly,
 __
 Gabriel 
 Co-founder 
 Lasclay
